description: GDELT DOC 2.0 API — per-obligor adverse-tone article search

fetches.notes: Pre-hash filename. An earlier record for this same filename, the quoted-phrase query %22XPO%22, was removed from this manifest: GDELT answered it with HTTP 200 and the 35-byte plain-text body 'The specified phrase is too short.', and the unquoted retry then overwrote those bytes under the identical name. Its sha256 could no longer be verified against anything on disk, so the record was dropped rather than left asserting a hash for bytes that are gone. Payload filenames now carry a query hash so two queries can no longer collide.
